content: I'm not a crypto expert by any means, so take this with a grain of salt. I thought it'd be interesting to share that I've been able to get Claude to implement cryptography algorithms in Lean 4 without much back-and-forth. Here is BLAKE3: https://github.com/BuildCoherence/Blake3Lean4 with proofs of I/O pairs. I haven't been able to find any other public implementations.
If you are not a cryptographer and this is just LLM code, then you really should call both of those out at the top of out your GitHub README

Noting also https://github.com/kim-em/lean-crypto-hash

This repository was written using Claude Code. Use with appropriate skepticism.

(There is no verification in this library, as I'm unaware of any useful theorems to even state. It has conformance tests with system tools.)
This topic was moved here from #Machine Learning for Theorem Proving > Cryptography implemented with AI by Kim Morrison.
For formalized cryptography in Lean, there is https://github.com/Verified-zkEVM/VCV-io though I'm not sure how useful it is for proving correctness of hashing algorithms.
